about: An open source app for splitting shared bills with friends, like Splitwise.

prs.title: Splitwise import keeps who owes whom
prs.broken: Importing balances from Splitwise dropped the minus sign, so money you owed a friend was imported as money they owed you.
prs.changed: Balances are now read with their sign, so debts come across in the right direction.
prs.matters: People switching from Splitwise start with correct balances instead of flipped debts.
